title: Smart Plant Monitoring System
description: An Arduino-based smart plant monitoring and automated watering system using RemoteXY. The system monitors environmental conditions and controls watering based on plant requirements.

title: Diabetic Prediction
description: A machine learning project that predicts diabetes risk using patient health data. Includes data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis, model training, evaluation, and visualization to build a reproducible prediction pipeline.
features: Machine learning model training and evaluation

title: Foresight
description: A mobile application designed to identify and map forest features and paths. The app focuses on providing an intuitive navigation experience while helping users explore and understand forest environments.

title: Depression Risk Prediction From Lifestyle
description: A machine learning project that explores lifestyle factors and predicts depression risk using data analysis, feature engineering, and classification techniques.

title: University Grants Commission Website Redesign
description: A modern website redesign concept created to improve the usability, accessibility, and visual experience of the University Grants Commission website.

title: To-Do List Web Application
description: A responsive task management web application that allows users to create, update, delete, and organize daily tasks efficiently.

title: Java Calculator Application
description: A desktop calculator application developed using Java Swing that performs basic arithmetic operations through a graphical user interface.

title: Bothal Paththare
description: A waste management mobile application designed to encourage sustainable waste disposal practices and create a greener Sri Lanka through digital solutions.
